facts.fact: Subsea analyst Roderick Beck says all Nigerian cable landings are at Lekki except 2Africa, which has two landings, one 500 km south of Lagos, alongside WACS, ACE, MainOne, SAT3, GLO-1 and Equiano; he expected 2Africa live by early 2025.
